text: A checkpointer saves graph state by thread_id. Reuse the same thread_id to resume the same conversation; use a new one for an independent run.
title: Persistence: threads

text: Pass the checkpointer when compiling the graph and include configurable.thread_id in every invocation that should be persisted.
title: Persistence configuration

text: An interrupt pauses execution and stores state. Resume with Command(resume=value) using the same thread_id.
title: Interrupts and resume

text: Code before an interrupt may run again after resume. Put side effects in idempotent tasks or after the interrupt boundary.
title: Interrupt side effects

text: GRAPH_RECURSION_LIMIT means the graph took too many steps without reaching a stop condition. Add a terminating route or set recursion_limit in configuration when the longer loop is intentional.
title: GRAPH_RECURSION_LIMIT

text: Tool failures should be represented in state and routed to bounded retry, repair, or escalation. Do not retry permanent validation errors indefinitely.
title: Tool error handling

text: Tool arguments must match the declared schema. Validate unknown tool names and malformed arguments before execution.
title: Tool schemas

text: After migrating from a legacy checkpoint API, replace legacy checkpoint imports with the current checkpointer API. Keep runtime configuration separate from persistent state and explicitly define reducers for fields updated by multiple nodes.
title: Migration: config and state

text: Use a checkpointer for thread-scoped memory and a store for information shared across threads.
title: Migration: memory

text: Parallel or repeated node updates overwrite state unless a reducer is declared. Annotate list fields with an append reducer when events must accumulate.
title: State reducers

text: Command can update state and route to another node in one return value. The destination still needs to be declared as a possible graph target.
title: Command routing

text: Use updates to stream node state deltas and values to stream complete state. Token streaming depends on the model integration.
title: Streaming modes

text: Older LangGraph releases used legacy checkpoint imports and invocation patterns. Prefer the current checkpointer API when upgrading.
title: Legacy checkpoint API

text: Async nodes must be invoked through async graph methods. Avoid blocking I/O inside async nodes because it stalls concurrent cases.
title: Async graph nodes
